name: fridgesnap.AI
summary: Takes a photo of your fridge and returns personalized recipes in three cuisines from the ingredients it sees.
description: fridgesnap.AI is a food app: you snap a photo of your fridge and get personalized recipes, with three cuisines crafted from the ingredients in the photo, plus dietary preferences. Monthly and annual plans start with a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime is stated for the monthly plan.

pricing.details: 7-day trial; Monthly Cook 9 €/month; Annual Chef 88 €/year; Founder’s Pass 446 € lifetime.
pricing.label: Premium

features: three cuisines per scan and dietary preferences
